title: ml/repair_scale hardened: dry-run convergence, tick-file crash, strict power-of-10 tolerance; 15 unit tests
summary: Validated Jeremiah's new repair_scale tool against the canonical dataset and fixed three real defects: dry-run re-reported flip #1 8x and missed later flips; old code crashed on all 14 tick parquets (log10 of non-positive ratio); and it would have 'repaired' genuine 31x-246x data jumps (incl 94x TICK-NYSE) as if they were x100 scale bugs. New tolerance 1e-3 in log10 cleanly separates float-noisy x100 appends from real jumps; non-positive closes skipped; --include filter added. Dataset verdict: 0 scale flips remain in the 80 parquet files (10-08 bug class fully repaired). Wet end-to-end test: injected x100 tail corruption restored bit-exact. master 8bf78c1; 15/15 unit tests pass. python3-pyarrow package request pending approval.
